main_body: Two wooden posts with a top beam and base feet, enclosing a hanging round gold gong seen face-on
top_band: Beam at x=16: row 2 light pinkish (L137), row 3 mid (L105), rows 4-5 dark (L49). That is a 1-2px edge line over a dark face, with no real top surface. Base feet at x=23: row 29 light, then dark rows 30-31, also only 1 row.
evidence: The frame is drawn straight on. The top beam is a roughly 4-row strip, with only a 1-2px light edge on top and the rest a vertical dark face. The posts are flat vertical strips with no top faces. The base feet show a 1-row highlight at most, and the gong is a face-on disc. The kind requires beams and base to show top faces, and none read as horizontal surfaces from above, so this is a front elevation with only a rim.

style.evidence: The gong has about 5 gold steps, from a pale highlight through to a dark brown rim, with a specular highlight and a shaded lower edge. The wood has 3-4 steps. Outlines are tinted dark brown, with 0% neutral edge pixels, and there are no flat 5x5 fills. Median colours per tile is 11 against 17-20 for the references, and total colours is 18 against about 40, so it is somewhat thinner than the references. It is still an acceptable, tinted, shaded piece next to them.
